n1.speaker: vida
n1.text: Let's write your first observation. You saw William build a tower and count the blocks, didn't you? Tell me exactly what happened.

translations.fa: بیا اولین مشاهده‌ات را بنویسیم. دیدی ویلیام یه برج ساخت و مکعب‌ها را شمرد، نه؟ دقیقاً بگو چی شد.

branches.suggestion: He built a tower with eight blocks and counted to five.
branches.suggestionFa: با هشت مکعب برج ساخت و تا پنج شمرد.

branches.suggestion: He was very clever with the blocks!

n2.speaker: vida
n2.text: Good — but "clever" is an opinion. An observation is objective: what he did and what he said, word for word.

translations.fa: خوبه — ولی «باهوش» نظره. مشاهده عینیه: کاری که کرد و چیزی که گفت، کلمه به کلمه.

branches.suggestion: So I write facts, not opinions.
Should I write his exact words?

match: i write the facts not the opinion

n3.speaker: vida
n3.text: Yes. Write it as a quote. What did he say?

translations.fa: آره. به صورت نقل‌قول بنویس. چی گفت؟

branches.suggestion: He said, "One, two, three, four, five — it's a big one!"
branches.suggestionFa: گفت: «یک، دو، سه، چهار، پنج — یه بزرگشه!»

n4.speaker: vida
n4.text: Lovely. Then link it to an area: counting is maths, and "a big one" is communication and language. Now, what's his next step?

translations.fa: عالی. بعد به یه حوزه وصلش کن: شمردن ریاضیه و «یه بزرگشه» ارتباط و زبان. حالا گام بعدیش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Counting past five, maybe up to ten.
branches.suggestionFa: شمردن بیشتر از پنج، شاید تا ده.

cultureNote.en: A good observation has three parts: what happened (with quotes), which EYFS area it shows, and a next step.
cultureNote.fa: مشاهدهٔ خوب: چه شد، کدام حوزه، گام بعدی.

n5.speaker: vida
n5.text: Both are good. Let's choose counting to ten and add some number games to next week's plan. Upload it with the photo, and Leslie will see it tonight.

translations.fa: هر دو خوبن. بیا شمردن تا ده را انتخاب کنیم و چند بازی عددی به برنامهٔ هفتهٔ بعد اضافه کنیم. با عکس آپلودش کن، لزلی امشب می‌بینتش.

branches.suggestion: Uploading it now. That was useful!
Do I need parent permission for the photo?

n6.speaker: vida
n6.text: Good thinking — yes, we check photo permissions for every child, and never show other children's faces in someone's journal.

translations.fa: خوب فکر کردی — آره، اجازهٔ عکس را برای هر بچه چک می‌کنیم و هیچ‌وقت صورت بچه‌های دیگه را تو دفتر یکی دیگه نشون نمی‌دیم.
